# Atlas Logged
> Privacy-first location tracking iOS app. Automatically tracks your travels with complete data privacy - all data stays on your device.

Atlas Logged is a mobile application for iOS that provides automatic location tracking with configurable privacy levels. The app is designed for travelers who want to maintain a personal travel history without compromising their privacy. All location data is stored locally on the user's device by default, with optional iCloud sync.

## Latest Updates
- [What's New](https://atlaslogged.com/changelog.html): Latest published version (1.2.0) — Our Biggest Update Yet
- [Roadmap](https://atlaslogged.com/roadmap.html): Upcoming features including photo integration, smart predictions, and visa tracking

## Product Information
- [Home](https://atlaslogged.com/): Main landing page with feature overview and download link
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/atlas-logged/id6538725214): Download Atlas Logged for iOS (requires iOS 17.0 or later)

## Key Features
- Automatic location tracking with 4 privacy levels: Country, City, Precise, and Maximum
- 100% on-device data storage with optional iCloud sync
- Battery efficient: Less than 1% battery usage per day
- Travel calendar with visual history and statistics
- Manual entry fallback for privacy-conscious users
- Photo integration with travel timeline

## Privacy & Support
- [Privacy Policy](https://atlaslogged.com/privacy.html): Complete transparency about data handling - no collection, no transmission, uses only Apple's native frameworks (Core Location, Core Data, CloudKit)
- [Location FAQ](https://atlaslogged.com/location-faq.html): Common questions about location permissions, battery usage, and iOS background tracking

## Technical Details
- Platform: iOS 17.0 or later
- Technologies: Core Location, Core Data, CloudKit (optional), PhotoKit (optional)
- Price: Free
- Developer: Atlas Codes
- Contact: support@atlascodes.ai

## Use Cases
Atlas Logged is ideal for travelers, digital nomads, frequent business travelers, and anyone who wants to maintain a private record of places they've visited. The app emphasizes user privacy and data ownership over cloud-based tracking solutions.























# Version History

## Version 1.2.0 - 2026-08-22
Our Biggest Update Yet

### New Features
- **Multi-Device Support**: Use Atlas Logged across all your devices with seamless sync
- **iCloud Backup**: Your travel history is now safely backed up to iCloud
- **Photo History**: See your photos alongside your country stays and travel timeline
- **Feedback & Support**: New feedback screen to easily get in touch with us
- **Time Zones, Done Right**: Each day now knows the time zone you lived it in: photos line up with your travel days, and a new Time Zone card shows the local time there versus your time now.
- **Home Nations, Day by Day**: Trips around the UK now show England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland per day - a drive from Wales into England shows both, in order.
- **Device Fleet Management**: Declare the devices you use, claim this one from the list, and rename, retire or hand over the primary role from Settings.

### Improvements
- **Onboarding Experience**: Completely redesigned setup flow to get you started faster
- **Calendar Reliability**: Stable month navigation and background refresh without snapping back
- **Performance**: Faster app launch and smoother navigation throughout
- **Switching to a New iPhone**: Upgrading moves your setup and history over cleanly - and the app now recognises your phone even when the system misreports its storage size.
- **Editing Your Stays**: Swipe to edit, hide or delete stays in your travel history, with clearer handling while history is being recalculated.

### Bug Fixes
- **Tracking Recovery**: Location tracking can no longer be silently left off after testing or unusual shutdowns - the app now detects and recovers from GPS outages.
- **Phantom Stays**: Fixed rare cases where the calendar invented days in a country you had already left.
- **Battery**: Fixed a loop that could quietly recalculate your history over and over after a long gap in tracking.
- **Offline Mode**: Choosing “stay offline” during setup now truly stays offline.
- **Photo History**: The photo timeline scan no longer looks stuck at 100% while it finishes up.
- **Privacy Settings**: Clearer wording for the highest-accuracy location level.
- **Calendar & Logging**: Fixed date selection, range validation, and manual log consistency
- **Stability**: Numerous bug fixes and reliability improvements
